issues.description: play.ts committed with local dev imports and debug console.log
issues.detail: play.ts was changed from `import * as z from 'zod/v4'` to a relative path into the source tree and now contains console.log debugging output. This looks like a scratch file accidentally committed. It will break for anyone consuming the repo and shouldn't ship in a feature PR.

issues.description: Override callback now fires twice for parent+child causing behavioral change
issues.detail: The test `override: do not run on references` previously expected overrideCount=6 and now expects 12 — exactly double. The removal of the `if (!seen.isParent)` guard around `ctx.override(...)` means user-supplied override hooks now run on parent (intermediate) clones as well as the final schema. This is a silent behavior change that may double-invoke side-effectful overrides for existing users.

issues.description: JSON.stringify equality used for property de-duplication is fragile
issues.detail: Two places use `JSON.stringify(schema[key]) === JSON.stringify(refSeen.def![key])` to decide whether to drop a property. This is sensitive to key ordering for objects and won't equate semantically-equal-but-differently-ordered objects, and silently fails for undefined/functions. Consider a structural compare or a more explicit ownership model.

issues.description: Parent-only property stripping deletes any key not in the cached child schema
issues.detail: The `isParentRef` branch iterates `for (const key in schema)` and deletes any key not present in `_cached`. If a processor added child-relevant keys after the cache snapshot (or via Object.assign from the parent that should be inherited), they will be removed. The interaction with the subsequent `refSchema.$ref` block (which also mutates schema) is hard to reason about.

issues.description: Mini schemas behavior changed to pass `parent: true`, but no mini test added
issues.detail: `mini/schemas.ts` flips the previously commented-out `{ parent: true }` to active, mirroring the classic change. This changes mini's metadata/$ref propagation behavior but the PR adds no mini-targeted test. Given the bug surfaced in classic (file processor), mini deserves an analogous regression test.

issues.description: Seen.ref type narrowed from `| undefined | null` semantics — sentinel usage unclear
issues.detail: The `ref` field comment says it's a schema to inherit from, but elsewhere `seen.ref = null` is used as a 'already processed' sentinel. Mixing 'no ref', 'has ref', and 'consumed' into one field is error-prone. Consider a separate boolean (`processed`) to make the recursion guard explicit.

review.summary: The PR fixes a real metadata/$ref propagation issue and adds good regression tests, but it ships with a clearly accidental `play.ts` debug script. The semantic change to override invocation (now firing on parent clones, doubling overrideCount in the existing test from 6 to 12) is a behavior change that deserves a changelog note or reconsideration. Several spots rely on `JSON.stringify` for property equality and on key-presence in a cached snapshot to strip parent-only properties — both are fragile. The mini package gets the same parent-flag flip without a dedicated test.
